The following events took place in 420 BBY.

==Events==
*By this year, a [[blackneedle tree]] had been planted in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Oa Park]].<ref name="Date">The blackneedle tree is four hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old by the time of its appearance in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''. The tree appears in a flashback that takes place before the main events of the novel, dated by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Therefore, the tree must have been planted on Coruscant by [[420 BBY]]</ref>
